how_to_use: Prefer a licensed real model for a canonical subject. Poly Haven is built into the asset_* tools; for every other source download with the shell into assets/<source>/<id>/, import with blender_exec (bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf / wm.obj_import / wm.stl_import), keep real size, check dimensions against the real object, and add a CREDITS line.

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.access: Built in: asset_search / asset_download / asset_apply_hdri / asset_apply_material / asset_import_model. Public API, no key.
sources.notes: Props, scanned textures, HDRIs. API /info/<id>: type 0 = HDRI, 1 = texture, 2 = model. Texture dimensions are in millimetres. Poly Haven asks users to be told the assets come from Poly Haven.

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.access: Not wrapped: download the material zip yourself (shell/curl), then build the material with blender_exec.
sources.notes: PBR materials. Use the NormalGL map, never NormalDX. Dimensions in centimetres (0 = unknown).

sources.name: Z-Anatomy
sources.access: Direct download from GitHub, no key.
sources.notes: About 2,800 named structures; per-system FBX files (Joints100, SkeletalSystem100, MuscularSystem100). Share-alike applies to redistributed meshes.

sources.name: BodyParts3D (DBCLS)
sources.credit: BodyParts3D, (c) The Database Center for Life Science, CC BY 4.0
sources.access: Direct download, one OBJ per FMA id.
sources.notes: Parts are named by FMA id: look up the structure's id first.

sources.name: NIH 3D
sources.notes: Licences differ per model: read each one.

sources.name: Open Anatomy Project
sources.credit: Open Anatomy Project and the atlas authors.
sources.notes: Includes the SPL knee and brain atlases, with ligaments and cartilage segmented.

sources.name: RCSB PDB (+ Molecular Nodes add-on)
sources.license: PDB data CC0; Molecular Nodes add-on GPL (renders unaffected)
sources.access: Fetch by PDB id directly or with the Molecular Nodes add-on.
sources.notes: Protein, nucleic-acid and other molecular structures.

sources.name: Kenney
sources.access: No API; download the official pack zip from the listing.
sources.notes: Whole packs; each zip contains License.txt.

sources.name: game-icons.net
sources.credit: Icons made by <author>. Available on https://game-icons.net
sources.notes: Credit each icon's author (its folder). Each SVG is a black square path under a white icon path: recolour or drop via fill.

sources.name: Incompetech (Kevin MacLeod)
sources.credit: "<title>" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
sources.access: Public catalogue, one track per download.
sources.notes: About 1,400 tracks; never mirror the catalogue in bulk.

sources.name: Smithsonian 3D Open Access
sources.access: API with a key, or download from the object page.
sources.notes: Only items marked Open Access are CC0.

sources.name: NASA 3D Resources
sources.license: Free to use; no NASA endorsement implied; NASA brand rules apply
sources.notes: Never imply NASA endorses the video or use NASA insignia as branding.

sources.name: FreeCAD Parts Library
sources.license: Per part: CC-BY-3.0, credited to that part's author
sources.credit: <author>, FreeCAD Parts Library, CC BY 3.0 (author from the part's git history or .FCStd properties)
sources.access: Direct download from GitHub, no key.
sources.notes: About 2,500 parts ship an .stl (motors, gears, bearings, pulleys, couplings, a crankshaft, robots); the rest are .FCStd/.step only, which Blender cannot import directly. Parts, not whole machines: assemble mechanisms. URL-encode spaces in folder names. STL is usually millimetres: scale 0.001 and check dimensions.

sources.name: Sketchfab Download API
sources.license: Per model; filter to CC0 or CC-BY (CC-BY-SA fine with credit)
sources.access: Needs the user's Sketchfab API token: ask for it.
sources.notes: Check each model's licence before downloading.

sources.name: Objaverse
sources.access: objaverse Python package or the Hugging Face dataset.
sources.notes: Huge and uneven: inspect a candidate before using it.
